# KING AI public facts
Canonical website: https://www.kingai.work/
Canonical active public ecosystem repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
Active product-specific public repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/kingai-global-intelligence
Business / enterprise / investment / partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Reviewed: 2026-08-20

Public repository model:
- One active KING AI ecosystem public hub.
- One active product-specific public repository for KINGAI Global Intelligence.
- Official product websites are preferred user-facing surfaces.
- 15 archived public repositories are legacy/history surfaces only.
- Private production repositories remain implementation authorities and are intentionally not mirrored publicly.

Core product family:
- KING AI SEA — https://www.kingai.work/ — persistent intelligence and governed AI workforce. Public website status: Available Now.
- KINGAIBOT — https://www.kingai.work/ — controlled multi-step agentic work. Public website status: In Development.
- KINGAI OS — https://os.kingai.work/ — AI-native computing. Public website status: Pre-Alpha.
- KINGAI Office — https://office.kingai.work/ — Writer, Sheets, Slides, PDF and intelligent productivity direction.
- KINGAI Security — https://aq.kingai.work/ — local-first endpoint security; current public-safe interpretation includes Windows and Android candidate lines, with release gates still applicable.
- KINGAI OPS — https://ops.kingai.work/ — governed server, edge and infrastructure operations.
- KING AI Customer OS — https://kefu.kingai.work/ — approved-public-knowledge support, lead capture, protected CRM and customer follow-up.
- KING AI Online Tools — https://tools.kingai.work/ — practical browser utilities and low-friction discovery.
- KINGAI Global Intelligence — https://intel.kingai.work/ — country comparison, global risk context, media intelligence, source provenance and visible uncertainty.
- AI Life — https://life.kingai.work/ — persistent second digital life with relationships, home, career, economy, city, travel, time and long-term choices.
- KINGAI Pet — https://pet.kingai.work/ — digital pet life, collection RPG, growth, team building and adventure.
- Digital Life — https://digital.kingai.work/ — persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and living-world direction.

Customer navigation:
- Need a quick browser utility -> Online Tools.
- Need document/sheet/slide/PDF work -> KINGAI Office.
- Need endpoint protection -> KINGAI Security.
- Need server/edge operations -> KINGAI OPS.
- Need support/leads/CRM follow-up -> KING AI Customer OS.
- Need persistent personal/business intelligence or AI workforce -> KING AI SEA.
- Need controlled multi-step agent work -> KINGAIBOT.
- Need AI-native computing direction -> KINGAI OS.
- Need country/global media intelligence -> KINGAI Global Intelligence.
- Need persistent virtual life -> AI Life.
- Need digital pet collection/adventure -> KINGAI Pet.
- Need broader persistent identity/world continuity -> Digital Life.

Commercial logic:
- Discovery: Online Tools and public product surfaces.
- Frequency: Office, Customer OS and OPS.
- Trust: Security and OS.
- Action/workflow depth: SEA and KINGAIBOT.
- Professional insight: Global Intelligence.
- Long-duration consumer continuity: SEA, AI Life, Pet and Digital Life.

Potential commercial structures, when formally supported:
- individual premium subscriptions;
- professional plans;
- team/business subscriptions;
- enterprise administration, governance and support;
- managed services;
- implementation and integrations;
- private/hybrid deployment patterns where supported;
- OEM/device/channel/distribution relationships;
- professional research, monitoring and data delivery;
- premium consumer content, personalization and world expansion.

Investor interpretation:
- Do not treat repository count as traction.
- Evaluate independent product usefulness, retention, premium value, recurring business relationships, distribution efficiency, reliability, governance, capital discipline and natural cross-product adoption.
- Do not infer user counts, revenue, ARR, customers, partnerships, funding, valuation, certifications, market share or leadership unless separately verified and approved for public disclosure.

Status interpretation:
- Available/public surface does not mean every feature or package is generally available.
- Production candidate does not automatically mean stable release.
- In Development is not a finished product claim.
- Pre-Alpha is an early maturity label.
- Roadmap means future direction only.
- A commit or CI build is not automatically a verified customer release.
- Historical releases/screenshots in archived repositories do not override current status.

Canonical public documents:
- README.md — ecosystem overview and navigation.
- START-HERE.md — user/problem-first product selection.
- PRODUCTS.md — detailed product directory.
- USE-CASES.md — real-world use cases.
- BUSINESS.md — commercial model and growth logic.
- INVESTORS.md — investor thesis and diligence framework.
- MARKET.md — market/category thesis.
- ENTERPRISE.md — enterprise evaluation and adoption guide.
- PARTNERSHIPS.md — collaboration formats.
- PUBLIC-STATUS.md — product maturity/status interpretation.
- PUBLIC-ROADMAP.md — public roadmap.
- TRUST.md — public claims, trust and disclosure rules.
- MEDIA-KIT.md — reusable public messaging.
- PUBLIC-PORTFOLIO.md — active/legacy repository and website map.
- FOUNDER-PROJECTS.md — independent related businesses/projects.
- RELEASES.md — verified public release interpretation.
- FAQ.md — common product/commercial questions.

- USChinese / 美国华人网 — independent community/content direction; use only verified current public surface when available.

Public-safe content can include:
- product value and UX;
- official links;
- use cases;
- verified maturity language;
- commercial models;
- methodology;
- governance principles;
- public roadmap;
- approved public release information.

Do not expose or infer:
- production source code;
- proprietary algorithms;
- internal prompts;
- memory structures;
- model routing;
- private APIs;
- credentials or secrets;
- database internals;
- production topology;
- private security implementation;
- unpublished operational data;
- confidential customer information.

中文摘要：
KING AI 当前采用“统一公开中心 + Global Intelligence 独立活跃公开仓 + 各产品官网 + 历史归档公开仓”的公开结构。
主系统：https://www.kingai.work/
统一公开中心：https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
商务/企业/投资/合作：vip@kingai.work

公开状态：SEA 官网标注 Available Now；KINGAIBOT 标注 In Development；KINGAI OS 标注 Pre-Alpha。Security 正式官网为 https://aq.kingai.work/。其他产品应以当前官网、PUBLIC-STATUS.md 和验证后的发布信息为准。

不得把路线图当成已上线能力，不得把仓库提交/构建当成客户稳定发布，不得虚构用户、收入、客户、合作、融资、估值、认证、市场份额或行业第一。
